Assess current state, identify customer requirements, and define the future state and/or business solution. Research, gather and synthesize information. Must have skills : Life Sciences R&D Good to have skills : Veeva Vault, Business Requirements Analysis, Life Sciences Industry Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with a strong background in Life Sciences R&D, supporting domains such as Clinical, Regulatory, and/or Patient Safety. The role is responsible for managing business requirements, change requests, and system enhancements across R&D IT applications, ensuring effective translation of business needs into scalable, compliant solutions. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of experience in Life Sciences, hands on exposure to R&D IT systems, and proven ability to work closely with application configuration and support teams to coordinate the design, development, and delivery of system features and changes. Proficiency with change and delivery management tools such as Jira and ServiceNow is essential. Must Have Skills: Life Sciences BA Experience with Minimum of 5 years in Life Sciences R&D, supporting domains such as Clinical, Regulatory, and/or Patient Safety is Mandatory. Lead end to end requirements management, including enhancements, defect fixes, and change requests Act as a liaison between business stakeholders, application configuration teams, and support teams Coordinate the development, testing, and delivery of features and system changes Support prioritization, impact assessment, and traceability of requirements across R&D systems Manage and track changes using Jira and ServiceNow Ensure solutions align with R&D processes, regulatory expectations, and validated system environments Experience & Skills Minimum 5 years of experience in Life Sciences, supporting R&D domains (Clinical, Regulatory, Safety) Experience working with R&D IT applications in regulated environments Strong skills in business analysis, stakeholder management, and process understanding Proficiency in change and delivery management tools (Jira, ServiceNow) Strong analytical, communication, and cross functional coordination capabilities The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Life Sciences BA, Veeva Vault BA or any other Life Sciences BA Experience is Mandatory, This position is based at our Hyderabad office. A 15 years full time education is required.
